a.en: one; used before a singular noun

abandoned.ex: The club abandoned its old website last year.
abandoned.ja: 使用をやめた；放棄した

acknowledging.ex: She acknowledged that the test was too hard.

admitted.en: said that something is true, often unwillingly
admitted.ex: He admitted that he had lost the keys.

adopted.en: started to use a method or product
adopted.ex: Many schools have adopted the new app.

advice.en: an opinion about what someone should do
advice.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about exams.

agencies.en: government organisations with a special job
agencies.ex: Two agencies are working on the new rules.

also.ex: She also speaks a little French.

although.en: even though; despite the fact that

an.en: one; used before a vowel sound

any.en: even one; it does not matter which

apparatus.en: a large organisation and its system of work
apparatus.ex: The state's security apparatus grew quickly after the war.

approval.en: official agreement that something is acceptable
approval.ex: The plan needs approval from the city council.
approval.zh: 批准；認可（seal of approval：認可）

approved.ex: The new medicine was approved last month.

armaments.ex: The country spends a lot on armaments.

army.ex: Her brother joined the army at eighteen.

asked.ex: We asked the guide for directions.

assistance.ex: The firm offered technical assistance to users.

associated.ex: Doctors have associated the illness with poor diet.

authorised.ex: Only authorised staff can enter this room.
authorised.ja: 認可された；許可された

based.en: having its main office in a place
based.ex: The bank is based in Dublin.

bearing.en: having or carrying a name or mark
bearing.ex: He found a box bearing his father's name.

bears.en: has or carries a mark or sign
bears.ex: Each bottle bears the company's logo.
bears.zh: 帶有（bear the seal of approval：獲得認可）

bodies.ex: Several public bodies support the project.

business.en: a company that sells goods or services
business.ex: She runs a small business from home.

called.ex: They have a dog called Max.

carried.ex: The survey was carried out by students.

centre.en: an organisation or place for a special activity
centre.ex: The research centre opened a new lab.

certified.en: officially said to meet a standard
certified.ex: The food is certified as organic.

checks.en: looks at something to see if it is correct
checks.ex: The teacher checks our homework every day.

clients.en: people or firms who pay for a service
clients.ex: The lawyer meets new clients on Mondays.

code.ex: He wrote the code for the game himself.

collaboration.ex: The film was made in collaboration with a French studio.

example.en: The study was done in collaboration with two universities.
example.zh: 這項研究是與兩所大學合作完成的。

note.meaning: 合作；與他人共同完成某項工作。
note.usage: 常見 in collaboration with…、collaboration between A and B；動詞為 collaborate。

noteEn.meaning: working together with other people or groups.
noteEn.usage: Common: 'in collaboration with'; the verb is 'collaborate'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El estudio se realizó en colaboración con dos universidades.
noteEs.meaning: trabajo conjunto con otras personas o grupos.
noteEs.usage: Común: in collaboration with…, collaboration between A and B; el verbo es collaborate.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह अध्ययन दो विश्वविद्यालयों के सहयोग से किया गया।
noteHi.meaning: दूसरों के साथ मिलकर काम करना; सहयोग।
noteHi.usage: in collaboration with…, collaboration between A and B आम हैं; क्रिया collaborate है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その研究は2つの大学と共同で行われた。
noteJa.meaning: 他者と協力して仕事をすること；協力。
noteJa.usage: in collaboration with…、collaboration between A and B の形が多い。動詞は collaborate。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 연구는 두 대학과 협력하여 진행되었다.
noteKo.meaning: 다른 사람과 함께 일하는 것; 협력.
noteKo.usage: in collaboration with…, collaboration between A and B가 흔하며 동사는 collaborate이다.

commission.en: an official group with a special job
commission.ex: The commission will publish its report next week.

companies.en: businesses that make or sell things
companies.ex: Many companies now let staff work from home.

company.en: a business that makes or sells things
company.ex: My sister works for a software company.

company's.ex: The company's profits rose this year.

competition.en: businesses trying to win customers from each other
competition.ex: Competition between phone firms keeps prices low.
competition.zh: 競爭（Competition and Consumer Protection Commission：競爭與消費者保護委員會）

compromised.en: accessed or damaged by an attacker
compromised.ex: Hackers compromised thousands of email accounts.

example.en: The hospital said no patient data was compromised.
example.zh: 醫院表示沒有病患資料外洩。

note.meaning: （資料、系統、安全）遭到入侵、洩露或受損。
note.usage: 資訊安全常用被動式：data/security/an account was compromised；另有「妥協」之意，需看語境。

noteEn.meaning: accessed, damaged or exposed by an attacker.
noteEn.usage: Often passive in security: 'data was compromised'. It can also mean 'agree to give up something'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El hospital dijo que no se vieron comprometidos datos de pacientes.
noteEs.meaning: que los datos o un sistema han sido vulnerados o expuestos.
noteEs.usage: En ciberseguridad suele ir en pasiva: data was compromised; también significa ceder en un acuerdo.

noteHi.exampleTr: अस्पताल ने कहा कि किसी मरीज़ का डेटा लीक नहीं हुआ।
noteHi.meaning: डेटा या सिस्टम में सेंध लगना या उसकी सुरक्षा भंग होना।
noteHi.usage: साइबर सुरक्षा में प्रायः passive: data was compromised; 'समझौता करना' का अर्थ भी होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 病院は患者のデータは漏洩していないと述べた。
noteJa.meaning: データやシステムが侵害・漏洩されること。
noteJa.usage: 情報セキュリティでは受動態が多い：data was compromised。「妥協する」の意味もあるので文脈に注意。

noteKo.exampleTr: 병원은 환자 데이터가 유출되지 않았다고 밝혔다.
noteKo.usage: 보안 분야에서는 수동태가 흔하다: data was compromised; '타협하다'라는 뜻도 있다.

computer.en: an electronic machine for working with information
computer.ex: I use my computer for school work.

conceding.en: admitting something you would rather not
conceding.ex: The coach conceded that the team played badly.

example.en: The minister conceded that mistakes had been made.
example.zh: 部長承認確實出了一些錯。

note.meaning: （往往不情願地）承認某事屬實。
note.usage: 常見 concede that…；新聞中常與 while 連用，表示一邊否認一邊承認部分事實。

noteEn.meaning: to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true.
noteEn.usage: Often 'concede that'; in news, 'while conceding' adds a partial admission.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ministro admitió que se habían cometido errores.
noteEs.meaning: admitir, a menudo a regañadientes, que algo es cierto.
noteEs.usage: Común: concede that…; en noticias suele ir con while para matizar una negación.

noteHi.exampleTr: मंत्री ने माना कि कुछ ग़लतियाँ हुई थीं।
noteHi.meaning: (अक्सर अनिच्छा से) किसी बात को सच मान लेना।
noteHi.usage: concede that… आम है; समाचारों में while के साथ आता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 大臣は誤りがあったことを認めた。
noteJa.meaning: （しぶしぶ）事実だと認めること。
noteJa.usage: concede that… の形が多い。報道では while と共に、否定しつつ一部を認める文脈で使われる。

noteKo.usage: concede that… 형태가 흔하며, 기사에서는 while과 함께 부인하면서 일부를 인정할 때 쓴다.

conducted.ex: The interviews were conducted by phone.

confirmed.ex: The hotel confirmed our booking by email.

connection.en: a link between things or people
connection.ex: Police found no connection between the two cases.

consulting.ex: Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

consumer.en: a person who buys goods or services
consumer.ex: The new law protects consumer rights.

corresponding.en: matching or similar to another thing
corresponding.ex: Sales rose, with a corresponding rise in profits.

customers.en: people who buy goods or services
customers.ex: The shop gives free coffee to customers.

cyber.en: related to computers and the internet
cyber.ex: Cyber attacks on banks are rising.

data.ex: Back up your data every week.

defence.en: protecting a country with military forces
defence.ex: The government is spending more on defence.

denies.en: says that something is not true
denies.ex: The singer denies all the rumours.

discontinued.ex: The shop discontinued its delivery service.

example.en: The bank discontinued its old mobile app in March.
example.zh: 這家銀行在三月停用了舊的手機應用程式。

note.meaning: 停止使用、停止提供或停產某項產品或服務。
note.usage: 多用於正式語境，常見 discontinue use of sth / discontinue a product；比 stop 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: to stop using, offering or making something.
noteEn.usage: A formal word; common in 'discontinue use of' and 'a discontinued product'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El banco dejó de ofrecer su antigua aplicación móvil en marzo.
noteEs.meaning: dejar de usar, ofrecer o fabricar un producto o servicio.
noteEs.usage: Es formal; se usa discontinue use of algo / discontinue a product.

noteHi.exampleTr: बैंक ने मार्च में अपना पुराना मोबाइल ऐप बंद कर दिया।
noteHi.meaning: किसी उत्पाद या सेवा का उपयोग या आपूर्ति बंद करना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; discontinue use of sth, discontinue a product आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: その銀行は3月に古いモバイルアプリの提供を終了した。
noteJa.meaning: 製品やサービスの使用・提供・生産をやめること。
noteJa.usage: stop より改まった語。discontinue use of 〜、discontinue a product の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 은행은 3월에 기존 모바일 앱 서비스를 중단했다.
noteKo.usage: stop보다 격식 있는 말; discontinue use of ~, discontinue a product 형태가 흔하다.

dismissed.en: refused to accept an idea as true
dismissed.ex: The mayor dismissed the claims as nonsense.

distributed.ex: The game is distributed in over fifty countries.
distributed.ja: 販売される；流通される

documentation.en: written guides that explain how to use something
documentation.ex: Read the documentation before installing the app.

domestic.ex: Domestic flights are cheaper this winter.

employed.ex: The team employed new methods to test the software.

encompassed.ex: The course encompassed history, art and music.
encompassed.ja: 含んでいた；網羅していた

example.en: The festival encompassed music, film and dance.
example.zh: 這場藝術節涵蓋了音樂、電影和舞蹈。

note.meaning: 包含、涵蓋（多種不同的事物）。
note.usage: 正式用語，強調範圍廣：encompass a wide range of…；比 include 更正式。

noteEn.usage: More formal than 'include'; often 'encompass a wide range of'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El festival abarcó música, cine y danza.
noteEs.meaning: incluir o abarcar muchas cosas diferentes.
noteEs.usage: Formal; destaca un alcance amplio: encompass a wide range of…; más formal que include.

noteHi.exampleTr: उत्सव में संगीत, फ़िल्म और नृत्य शामिल थे।
noteHi.meaning: कई अलग-अलग चीज़ों को शामिल करना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक; दायरा बड़ा दिखाता है; encompass a wide range of… आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その祭典は音楽、映画、ダンスを網羅していた。
noteJa.meaning: 様々なものを含む・網羅すること。
noteJa.usage: include より改まった語で、範囲の広さを強調。encompass a wide range of… の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 축제는 음악, 영화, 무용을 아울렀다.
noteKo.usage: include보다 격식 있고 범위가 넓음을 강조; encompass a wide range of… 형태가 흔하다.

entails.en: involves something as a necessary part
entails.ex: The job entails a lot of travel.

example.en: Moving abroad entails a lot of paperwork.
example.zh: 移居國外需要辦理大量文件手續。

note.meaning: 必然涉及、包含或需要某事。
note.usage: 正式用語，主詞多為事情或過程：sth entails sth / entails doing sth；不用進行式。

noteEn.meaning: to involve something as a necessary part.
noteEn.usage: Formal; 'X entails Y' or 'entails doing'. Not used in -ing tenses.

noteEs.exampleTr: Mudarse al extranjero conlleva mucho papeleo.
noteEs.meaning: implicar o requerir algo como parte necesaria.
noteEs.usage: Formal; algo entails algo / entails doing algo; no suele usarse en forma continua.

noteHi.exampleTr: विदेश जाकर बसने में बहुत काग़ज़ी कार्रवाई शामिल होती है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को आवश्यक रूप से शामिल करना या मांगना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; sth entails sth / entails doing sth; प्रायः continuous रूप में नहीं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 海外移住には多くの書類手続きが伴う。
noteJa.meaning: 必然的に〜を伴う・必要とすること。
noteJa.usage: 改まった語。主語は物事や手続き：sth entails sth / doing。進行形にしない。

noteKo.exampleTr: 해외 이주에는 많은 서류 작업이 수반된다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 일을 필연적으로 포함하거나 필요로 하다.
noteKo.usage: 격식어; 주어는 일·절차: sth entails sth / doing; 진행형으로 쓰지 않는다.

eu-sanctioned.en: punished with official limits by the EU
eu-sanctioned.ex: The bank froze money from EU-sanctioned firms.

even.ex: Even the logos looked the same.

evidence.en: facts that show something is true
evidence.ex: There is no evidence that the phone was hacked.

exclusively.ex: The club is exclusively for members.

example.en: The new phone is sold exclusively online.
example.zh: 這款新手機只在網路上販售。

note.meaning: 只、僅僅；專門提供給某些人。
note.usage: 常放在動詞或介系詞片語前：sold exclusively to…、exclusively for…；比 only 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: only, and not for anyone or anything else.
noteEn.usage: Common in 'sold exclusively to' and 'exclusively for'; more formal than 'only'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo teléfono se vende exclusivamente por internet.
noteEs.usage: Común en sold exclusively to…, exclusively for…; más formal que only.

noteHi.exampleTr: नया फ़ोन केवल ऑनलाइन बेचा जाता है।
noteHi.meaning: केवल; सिर्फ़ कुछ लोगों के लिए।
noteHi.usage: sold exclusively to…, exclusively for… आम हैं; only से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: その新しい携帯電話はオンライン限定で販売されている。
noteJa.meaning: もっぱら；〜だけに限って。
noteJa.usage: sold exclusively to…、exclusively for… の形が多い。only より改まった語。

noteKo.usage: sold exclusively to…, exclusively for… 형태가 흔하며 only보다 격식 있다.

fact.ex: Despite the fact that it rained, we went out.
fact.zh: 事實（despite the fact that：儘管）

firm.ex: She joined a law firm after university.

firms.ex: Many firms make parts for cars.

flagged.en: pointed out a problem as needing attention
flagged.ex: The report flagged several safety problems.

found.ex: The study found a link between sleep and memory.

founders.ex: The founders started the company in a garage.

from.en: showing the start of a range

guides.en: books or papers that explain how to use something
guides.ex: The user guides are on the website.

had.en: used to form the past perfect

handover.en: passing control or duties to someone else
handover.ex: The handover to the new manager took a month.

has.en: used to form the present perfect

have.en: used to form the present perfect

helping.ex: He was helping his friend with the project.
helping.zh: 幫助；協助（help with：協助處理）

however.en: used to add a contrasting point
however.ex: The test was hard. However, most students passed.

identified.ex: Engineers identified a fault in the system.

including.en: and also; as part of a group

indistinguishable.en: so alike you cannot see a difference
indistinguishable.ex: The fake watch was indistinguishable from the real one.
indistinguishable.hi: अभिन्न; अलग न पहचाने जा सकने वाले

example.en: The copy was almost indistinguishable from the original painting.
example.zh: 這幅複製品與原畫幾乎無法分辨。

note.meaning: 無法分辨的；幾乎一模一樣的。
note.usage: 常用 indistinguishable from sth；可加 almost / virtually 修飾。

noteEn.meaning: so alike that you cannot see any difference.

noteEs.exampleTr: La copia era casi indistinguible del cuadro original.
noteEs.meaning: tan parecido que no se puede notar la diferencia.
noteEs.usage: Se usa indistinguishable from algo; a menudo con almost o virtually.

noteHi.exampleTr: नकल मूल चित्र से लगभग अलग नहीं पहचानी जा सकती थी।
noteHi.meaning: इतने एक जैसे कि अंतर न पहचाना जा सके।
noteHi.usage: indistinguishable from sth आम है; almost/virtually के साथ भी।

noteJa.exampleTr: その複製は原画とほとんど見分けがつかなかった。
noteJa.meaning: 区別がつかないほど似ている。
noteJa.usage: indistinguishable from 〜 の形が多く、almost / virtually で修飾される。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 복제품은 원본 그림과 거의 구별할 수 없었다.
noteKo.meaning: 차이를 알 수 없을 정도로 똑같은.
noteKo.usage: indistinguishable from ~ 형태가 흔하며 almost, virtually와 함께 쓴다.

indistinguishable.zh: 無法分辨的；一模一樣的

insists.en: says firmly that something is true
insists.ex: She insists that she paid the bill.

inspect.en: look at something closely to check it
inspect.ex: Officers will inspect the building tomorrow.

inspection.en: a close official check of something
inspection.ex: The car failed its safety inspection.

intelligence.ex: The intelligence service warned of a cyber attack.

investigation.en: a careful study to find the truth
investigation.ex: The newspaper's investigation took six months.

iteration.ex: The latest iteration of the phone is lighter.

joint.en: done by two or more groups together
joint.ex: The two schools held a joint concert.

keeps.en: makes something stay in a certain state
keeps.ex: A good lock keeps your bike safe.

laboratory.ex: The samples were sent to a laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 實驗室（State Laboratory：國家實驗室）

lent.ex: Local people lent their support to the campaign.

limited.ex: The museum has limited space for visitors.

link.ex: There is a strong link between diet and health.

linked.ex: The report linked the fire to a faulty cable.

logos.ex: The two shops have very similar logos.

looked.ex: The police looked into the case.

lost.ex: My phone was lost on the train.

make.ex: This factory makes parts for bikes.

manuals.en: books that explain how to use something
manuals.ex: The printer came with two thick manuals.

manufacturers.en: companies that make goods in large numbers
manufacturers.ex: Car manufacturers are moving to electric models.

marketed.ex: The drink is marketed to young people.
marketed.ja: 販売される；売り出される

matching.en: the same as or very like another
matching.ex: They wore matching shirts at the party.

military.ex: The military helped after the flood.

ministry.ex: The ministry will announce new rules today.

moreover.en: used to add another important point
moreover.ex: The flat is cheap. Moreover, it is near the station.

moscow's.zh: 莫斯科的（指俄羅斯政府）

name.en: the word that something is called
name.ex: The café changed its name last year.

national.en: of or belonging to a whole country
national.ex: The national team won the final.

necessitates.ex: The new law necessitates changes to our software.

example.en: The storm damage necessitates urgent repairs.
example.zh: 暴風雨造成的損害使緊急維修成為必要。

note.usage: 非常正式，主詞為情況或規定：sth necessitates sth / doing sth；口語多用 require 或 need。

noteEn.usage: Very formal; in everyday English use 'require' or 'need'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los daños de la tormenta hacen necesarias reparaciones urgentes.
noteEs.usage: Muy formal; el sujeto es una situación o norma; en lenguaje común se usa require o need.

noteHi.exampleTr: तूफ़ान से हुए नुकसान के कारण तुरंत मरम्मत ज़रूरी है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को आवश्यक बना देना।
noteHi.usage: बहुत औपचारिक; बोलचाल में require या need अधिक प्रयोग होते हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 嵐の被害により緊急の修理が必要となっている。
noteJa.meaning: 〜を必要にさせる；必要とする。
noteJa.usage: 非常に改まった語。主語は状況や規則。日常では require や need を使う。

noteKo.usage: 매우 격식 있는 말; 주어는 상황·규정이며 일상에서는 require, need를 쓴다.

nevertheless.en: despite what has just been said
nevertheless.ex: It was raining. Nevertheless, the match went ahead.

news.ex: She reads the news on her phone every morning.

newspaper.en: a paper with news, or the company making it
newspaper.ex: The newspaper printed the story on Monday.

now.ex: The shop is now open on Sundays.

office.ex: The tax office sent me a letter.
office.zh: 辦公室；（政府）機關（Office of Public Works：公共工程局）

offices.ex: Both offices closed early on Friday.

official.ex: We are waiting for an official answer.

officials.en: people with important jobs in government
officials.ex: City officials met to discuss the plan.

only.en: and no one or nothing else
only.ex: The museum is only open in summer.

organisations.en: groups of people working for one purpose
organisations.ex: Many organisations help people find work.

original.ex: The original founders still own part of the firm.

out.en: used in "carry out" (to do a task)
out.ex: They carried out tests on the water.

owner.ex: The owner of the café is very friendly.

parallels.en: ways in which things are similar
parallels.ex: The film has clear parallels with real events.

partners.en: people or groups that work together
partners.ex: We worked with partners in five countries.

password-management.ex: A password-management app can store all your logins.

paragraphs: Three Irish State offices have stopped using a computer program. The program is called Passwork. It keeps passwords safe.

In July, The Irish Times looked into Passwork. It found that the program was very like a Russian program. The Russian version is approved by Russia's spy service. It is sold to Russian companies that make weapons.
The Irish offices used a version sold by a company in Spain. But the two programs had the same code and the same user guides. The owner of the Spanish company says it has no link to Russia.

The three offices are the State Laboratory, the Office of Public Works and the consumer watchdog. Ireland's cyber security centre found no risks. Still, all three stopped using Passwork. One office says no data was lost.
sentZh: 三個愛爾蘭政府機關已停止使用一款電腦程式。
這個程式叫做 Passwork。
它能保護密碼的安全。
七月時，《愛爾蘭時報》調查了 Passwork。
報社發現這個程式和一款俄羅斯程式非常相似。
俄羅斯版本獲得俄羅斯間諜機構的核准。
它被賣給製造武器的俄羅斯公司。
愛爾蘭這些機關使用的是一家西班牙公司販售的版本。
但這兩個程式有相同的程式碼和相同的使用指南。
這家西班牙公司的老闆說，公司和俄羅斯沒有關聯。
這三個機關是國家實驗室、公共工程局和消費者監管機構。
愛爾蘭的網路安全中心沒有發現任何風險。
即便如此，三個機關都停止使用 Passwork。
其中一個機關表示，沒有任何資料遺失。

paragraphs: Three Irish State agencies have stopped using a password-management program called Passwork, after a newspaper investigation linked it to Russia.

In July, The Irish Times, working with other news organisations in Europe, reported that the program sold by a company in Spain was very similar to a Russian program with the same name. The two versions shared original computer code, update times, user guides and even logos.
The Russian version is only sold to Russian customers. Some of them make weapons for the Russian army. It has also been approved by Russia's security service, the FSB, which checks the computer code.

The State Laboratory, the Office of Public Works and the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission all used the Spanish product. They asked the National Cyber Security Centre for advice, and it found no risks. Still, all three have now stopped using it. The State Laboratory said there was no sign that any data was stolen.
The owner of the Spanish company, Alexander Muntyan, says his business has no link to Russia. However, he admitted that one of the Russian founders had been helping with the product.
sentZh: 一項報紙調查將一款名為 Passwork 的密碼管理程式與俄羅斯連結起來後，三個愛爾蘭政府機構已停止使用它。
七月時，《愛爾蘭時報》與歐洲其他新聞機構合作報導，一家西班牙公司販售的程式與一款同名的俄羅斯程式非常相似。
兩個版本有相同的原始程式碼、更新時間、使用指南，甚至連標誌都一樣。
俄羅斯版本只賣給俄羅斯客戶。
其中有些客戶為俄羅斯軍隊製造武器。
它也獲得俄羅斯安全機構「聯邦安全局」（FSB）的核准，該機構會檢查其程式碼。
國家實驗室、公共工程局以及競爭與消費者保護委員會都使用了這款西班牙產品。
他們向國家網路安全中心尋求建議，該中心沒有發現任何風險。
即便如此，三個機構現在都已停止使用。
國家實驗室表示，沒有跡象顯示有任何資料遭竊。
這家西班牙公司的老闆亞歷山大・蒙蒂安表示，他的公司與俄羅斯沒有關聯。
不過，他承認其中一位俄羅斯創辦人曾協助開發這項產品。

paragraphs: Three Irish State agencies have stopped using a password-management service after an investigation linked it to a Russian company whose software is approved by Moscow's intelligence service.

The product, Passwork, is sold by a company based in Spain. However, an investigation by The Irish Times, carried out with international partners and published in July, found striking similarities with a Russian product of the same name. These included shared source code, identical user manuals, matching update schedules and the same logos.

The Russian version is sold only to Russian clients, including firms under EU sanctions that produce weapons for the Russian military. It is certified by the FSB and Russia's Ministry of Defence, a process that requires officials to inspect its source code.

The State Laboratory, the Office of Public Works and the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission had all used the Spanish version, some since 2022. After consulting the National Cyber Security Centre, which identified no risks, all three have ceased using it. The State Laboratory said there was no evidence that any data had been compromised.
The Spanish company's owner, Alexander Muntyan, denies any link to Russia, though he confirmed that one of the original founders provided limited support during a two-year transition.
sentZh: 一項調查將某款密碼管理服務與一家俄羅斯公司連結起來，而該公司的軟體獲得莫斯科情報機構核准；三個愛爾蘭國家機構隨後已停止使用該服務。
這款名為 Passwork 的產品由一家總部設在西班牙的公司販售。
然而，《愛爾蘭時報》與國際夥伴合作、於七月發表的一項調查發現，它與一款同名俄羅斯產品有驚人的相似之處。
這些相似處包括共用的原始碼、相同的使用手冊、一致的更新時程，以及相同的標誌。
俄羅斯版本只賣給俄羅斯客戶，其中包括受歐盟制裁、為俄羅斯軍方生產武器的公司。
它獲得俄羅斯聯邦安全局（FSB）和俄羅斯國防部的認證，而這項程序要求官員檢查其原始碼。
國家實驗室、公共工程局以及競爭與消費者保護委員會都曾使用西班牙版本，有些從 2022 年就開始使用。
在諮詢國家網路安全中心、而該中心未發現任何風險之後，三個機構都已停止使用。
國家實驗室表示，沒有證據顯示任何資料遭到外洩。
這家西班牙公司的老闆亞歷山大・蒙蒂安否認與俄羅斯有任何關聯，不過他證實，其中一位原始創辦人在為期兩年的過渡期間提供了有限的支援。

paragraphs: Three Irish State bodies have quietly abandoned a password-management service after an investigation tied it to a Russian firm whose software bears the seal of approval of Moscow's intelligence apparatus.

Passwork is marketed by a Spanish-based company, but a joint investigation by The Irish Times and several European partners, published in July, unearthed uncanny parallels with a Russian product of the same name, from shared source code and identical user manuals to synchronised update schedules and matching logos.

The Russian iteration is sold exclusively to domestic clients, among them EU-sanctioned manufacturers supplying the Russian military. It has been certified by the FSB and Russia's Ministry of Defence, a process that entails officials scrutinising its source code.

The State Laboratory, the Office of Public Works and the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission had all adopted the Spanish version. Although the National Cyber Security Centre flagged no risks, each has since discontinued it, and the State Laboratory insists there is no evidence that data was compromised.
The Spanish firm's owner, Alexander Muntyan, has dismissed any Russian connection, while conceding that one of the original founders lent limited support during a two-year handover.

Passwork 由一家設於西班牙的公司行銷，但《愛爾蘭時報》與數家歐洲夥伴於七月發表的聯合調查，挖掘出它與一款同名俄羅斯產品之間不可思議的相似之處，從共用的原始碼、相同的使用手冊，到同步的更新時程和一樣的標誌。
俄羅斯版本只賣給國內客戶，其中包括受歐盟制裁、為俄羅斯軍方供貨的製造商。
它已獲得俄羅斯聯邦安全局（FSB）和俄羅斯國防部的認證，這項程序需要官員仔細審查其原始碼。
國家實驗室、公共工程局以及競爭與消費者保護委員會都曾採用西班牙版本。
雖然國家網路安全中心並未指出任何風險，但各機構此後都已停用，而國家實驗室堅稱沒有證據顯示資料遭到外洩。
這家西班牙公司的老闆亞歷山大・蒙蒂安駁斥與俄羅斯有任何關聯，同時也承認其中一位原始創辦人在為期兩年的交接期間提供了有限的支援。

The State Laboratory, the Office of Public Works and the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission had each employed the Spanish version. Despite the fact that the National Cyber Security Centre identified no risks, all three have subsequently ceased using it, and the State Laboratory has stated that there is no evidence of compromised data.

The owner of the Spanish company, Alexander Muntyan, has nevertheless rejected any connection to Russia, while acknowledging that one of the original founders provided limited assistance during a two-year transition period.
